source.snippet: I'm looking for a free or very low-budget tool. Needs: Kanban, online document storage, ticket workflow, multi-entity permissions where satellites are not concerned by all evolutions of the central entity. Working with external provider. French UI support required.

problem_statement: Small French-speaking organizations managing multi-entity projects (e.g., central body + satellite partners + external providers) cannot find an affordable project management tool that supports granular multi-entity permissions, collaborative docs, kanban, and a French interface in one product.
target_segment: Non-profit associations, public sector project teams, and SMEs in French-speaking markets (France, Belgium, Quebec) managing multi-stakeholder projects on zero or minimal budget
notes: Notion/Linear/Asana don't fully satisfy multi-entity permission granularity at free tiers, and French localization is inconsistent. A Notion-alternative tailored to French public/nonprofit sector could win on compliance and language.
